workouts.title: Muscle Up Work
workouts.description:
Muscle Up Work

A) 3 Sets:
Ring Support Hold :15-:30
Bottom Of Ring Dip Hold :15-:30

NOTES:
- For the ring support hold, lock your arms out as straight as possible and turn your hand out to the side. Think about keeping your pinkies tight to your body.
- Hold tension in the bottom of the ring dip hold.
Don't just hit the bottom and rest in that position.
ーーーー
B) Ring Kip Swing
3x10
Rest 1:00 Between Sets.
NOTES:
- Hold a t-shirt between your feet and focus on keeping your legs long in the backswing.
- Hold tension in your core.

C)  MUSCLE-UP DROP SETS.
4 Sets:
1:30
- Ring Muscle-Ups @ Add your Personal Record below - Add your Personal Record below
- 3-5 Burpee Ring Pull-Up
- Strict Ring Dips
- Dual Dumbbell Overhead Hold @ 2x50/2x35lbs till the end of 1:30
Rest 2:30 Actively on a Fan Bike or C2 Bike.

NOTES:
- One more set this week and last week of this.
- Choose whichever end of the muscle ups range is doable for you, unbroken and with good form. You should be able to focus on technique.
- Flow: you will complete the prescribed ring muscle-ups, then move onto burpee ring pull-ups for a number of reps you can keep fast, then strict ring dips until close to failure (i.e. within 1-2 reps of failure), and then finish the working time out with holding dumbbells overhead

workouts.title: Tempo Back Squat
workouts.description:
Tempo Pause Back Squat
5x3 @ +10lbs From Last Week / RPE 8-9; 13X1 Tempo
*Rest 2:00-3:00 Between Sets.

NOTES:

- "13X1" means that you will take :01 to descend, :03 at the bottom, stand fast, and :01 at the top to reset between reps.
- Keep the pause at full depth. Stand straight up from the bottom of each rep with no bounce.

workouts.description:
EMOM 40
1: 14/11 Cal Row
2: 6 Hang Squat Snatch @ 95/65lbs
3: 14/11 Cal Fan Bike
4: 60 Double Unders

NOTES:
- The row and fan bike should be completed in :45 or less on each round. Scale the prescribed calories up or down accordingly.
- The hang snatch should be full squat snatches and be done unbroken. Scale the weight up or down accordingly.
- The double unders should be done in :40 or less and don't need to be unbroken.
